name: Grape Matcha
description: A bold fusion of deep purple grape and ceremonial grade matcha. Rich, antioxidant-packed, and beautifully layered.

name: Strawberry Matcha
description: Sweet sun-ripened strawberries meet the earthy depth of premium matcha for a refreshing, vibrant blend.

name: Mint Matcha
description: Crisp garden mint infused with smooth ceremonial matcha. Cool, energizing, and incredibly refreshing.

name: Blueberry Matcha
description: Wild blueberries bursting with flavor, balanced by the subtle umami of our signature matcha blend.

name: Classic Matcha
description: The original. Pure, ceremonial-grade matcha whisked to perfection. A timeless ritual for the discerning palate.

name: Cherry Matcha
description: Tart Japanese cherries harmonize with silky matcha for an elegant, subtly sweet seasonal creation.

name: Tea Leaf Blend
description: A curated blend of hand-picked tea leaves and premium matcha. Complex, layered, and deeply soothing.

name: Kiwi Matcha
description: Bright tropical kiwi meets the grassy notes of young matcha. Zesty, lively, and full of vitamin C.

name: Yuzu Matcha
description: Rare Japanese yuzu citrus lends a floral, tangy brightness to our smooth ceremonial matcha. Utterly unique.

name: Sakura Matcha
description: Cherry blossom petals delicately perfume our finest spring matcha harvest. Floral, rare, and enchanting.
